_doc: CF-POSTURE-1 policy (foundation/cfposture.py). The Cloudflare account's settings as rules measured against the live account every day (cost-guard workflow). kind auto: a failure files Q-CFP-<id> and the passing probe closes it. kind gate: identity-bound, recorded with its default in effect, files no item. upload_paths: every file that uploads a Worker by the API; each upload must send `observability` or the deploy turns logs off. scan_exclude: path prefixes the upload scan skips (tests, and the reference copy of another fleet's code that this repository never deploys).

rules.title: every Worker keeps its logs on
rules.why: With logs off a failing Worker leaves no evidence, so no loop can find the cause. Measured 2026-11-20: ultrastable-site and tenant-ps-web had logs off although their configs turn them on.
rules.remedy: deploy the Worker through a path listed in upload_paths (each sends observability), or add observability to its config

rules.title: preview Workers idle past the limit are removed
rules.why: Each idea preview is a Worker that counts against the account's script limit and is never cleaned up. Measured 2026-11-20: eight us-idea-* Workers idle since 2026-11-15.
rules.remedy: have the spinoff sweep delete a preview Worker once its idea is launched or declined

rules.title: Cloudflare alerts go to a webhook the system reads
rules.why: The account's only notification policy mails a person. An incident, a usage spike or a certificate event must reach a loop, not an inbox.
rules.remedy: Q-YEAR-cloudflare-alerts: a signed webhook route on the tick Worker registered as the destination of a policy per required alert

rules.title: no API token expires inside the horizon
rules.why: A token that expires within the year stops deploys or cost samples with nobody to mint another.
rules.remedy: roll the token (POST /accounts/{id}/tokens/{token_id}/value) before it expires and store it through the deploy gateway

rules.title: every zone in the account is active
rules.why: A pending zone serves nothing from this account. Measured 2026-11-20: ultrastable.net pending behind a registrar lock.
rules.remedy: the daily single-account pass retries the nameserver switch

rules.title: the account has a second administrator
rules.why: One member means one sign-in is the only way into billing and the registrar.
rules.default: the system runs on API tokens that do not expire; nothing waits on the sign-in until a bill or a renewal fails
